title: the whole control of a session, on both paths
intent: A person must not lose the commands of a session when the agent moves from the attached placement to a service Emacs. The kernel asks a question that may be answered later, the queue of the person is written into the journal instead of living in a second state, the wire carries steer, withdraw and recover, a session opened again replays its journal, the service is the default entry point, the editor finds the service on a platform without Unix sockets, and the parity with other harnesses has an apparatus that measures instead of claiming.
objection: A shared control can hide a placement-specific truth: the editor may show a pending input that the service never queued, a steering may be delivered to a run that ended, a session replayed may carry events in another order than the live stream, and the service may become the default before the parity it promises is measured.
refuted_by: The journal and the queue of the editor disagree, a question is settled twice or a late answer mutates a finished run, the wire does not answer steer, withdraw or recover, a replay carries no earlier record, the editor cannot find the service over TCP, `M-x yeah' opens the attached path while the service is available, a harness that could not run is recorded as a pass, or a control that changes the scoped subject leaves the verifier green.
note: The request of a permission is journaled before the question is asked, and the adapter settles it exactly once. The pending queue is a projection of the journal events `input-queued`, `input-taken`, `input-recovered` and `input-withdrawn`. The ACP session runs on the same controller as the attached path, so the wire and the editor share one queue. `M-x yeah' opens the service placement and falls back to the attached one, in the open, when the service cannot start; `yeah-attached' opens the attached path by name; the bridge stays off. The family of the socket is chosen by the platform, and the port of a loopback TCP service is published in a file that holds the port number only. The live checks stay outside the map and are registered in docs/LIVE-EVIDENCE.md; the measurement apparatus in bench/ declares no threshold, because that threshold is a decision of the owner. The picture with pixels (16.6) and the measurements themselves (16.7) are still open.
